description: Use this when someone wants to know how many days they have used or have left in the Schengen Area under the 90/180 rule, or whether a planned trip would overstay. Pass every stay in any Schengen country with entry and exit dates. Do not use it for countries outside the Schengen Area, or for holders of an EU/EEA/Swiss passport, to whom the rule does not apply.

as_of.description: Date to assess on, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

stays.description: Each stay in the Schengen Area. Past and planned stays can be mixed.

entry.description: Arrival date, YYYY-MM-DD. Counts as a full day.

exit.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD. Counts as a full day.

name: calculate_schengen_days
title: Calculate Schengen days
